invariant_id: INV-041, INV-042, INV-053, INV-054; Corrected Rules 2, 3, 6
summary: Trend-pullback baseline geometry puts the SL inside its own entry zone (entry_min = swing_low-0.6ATR < SL = swing_low-0.2ATR; 33% of the zone is beyond the stop), 0.2 ATR from the limit, and the trailing swing window includes the evaluated bar, so 'pullback to support' fires on bars making a new 20-bar low.
expected: SL beyond the whole entry zone; setup level = confirmed prior pivot (family sheet L18, L116-118); minimum stop distance / cost-to-risk ceiling (Corrected Rule 3).
actual: p2: LONG zone 58820-59180, SL 58940 (inside), risk 0.102% of price, RR 41.7. p9 (full evaluate->plan->evaluate_risk): LONG signal on a bar 150 below every prior 19-bar low; SL inside zone; qty 0.305 BTC = 16.1x equity; fees at SL 11.24 vs allowed 5.00 -> real SL loss ~3.2R.
impact: Every baseline-v3 trend-pullback plan has a noise-level stop inside its zone; SL losses 1.4-3.2x budget (with KNOWN P11), notional 5-16x equity without leverage guard (KNOWN P13/P14); research measures a different setup than documented.
evidence: planner.py:105-114 `_sub(swing_low, sl_buffer)` with half=0.5ATR; :378-379 entry_min = zone_lower - entry_buffer; features.py:174-187 window candles[i-lookback+1..i] includes bar i; strategy.py:157 `support_lower <= last.low <= support_upper`; baseline-v3 zone_tolerance_atr=0.5, entry_buffer_atr=0.1, sl_buffer_atr=0.2.
why_tests_miss: Golden planner outputs regenerated from src; no test asserts SL outside zone, swing excluding current bar, or a stop-distance/notional bound.
recommendation: Planner invariant SL<entry_min (LONG)/SL>entry_max (SHORT) else NO_TRADE; SL beyond zone edge; confirmed pivots excluding the current bar; cost-to-risk ceiling + min stop distance; new parameter set/version and re-research.
known_prior: Root cause doc/plan F-909, F-113; compounds KNOWN P11, P13. Code facts NEW.

summary: execute_approved_plan takes the order symbol from risk_kwargs['constraint_snapshot'].symbol and the side from risk_kwargs['candidate_position_side']; TradePlan has no symbol/direction and nothing re-checks them or the SL-side geometry against the approved plan.
expected: Symbol and direction fixed by the approved, hashed plan/signal; placement rejects any mismatch and side-inconsistent SL geometry (INV-044 'a mismatch on any of them rejects').
actual: p13 on the repo's golden phase9 plan/approval: flipping candidate_position_side to SHORT places SELL 3.311 @101 with a BUY stop at 98 (profit side) -> OK; swapping the snapshot to ETHUSDT places the same prices on ETHUSDT -> OK.
impact: A single composition bug yields an unapproved instrument/side under a valid approval; a flipped plan can fill as a marketable limit with an immediately-triggering/invalid stop (naked). Latent until runtime composition (M1-M4) exists.
evidence: trade_plan.py:61-80 (no symbol/direction); manager.py:249-255 (only hash/id/expiry compared); :456-457, :470, :489-490, :512 (symbol/side from risk_kwargs); sizing.py:59 abs() distance.
why_tests_miss: Tests build risk_kwargs from the same fixture as the plan; no negative symbol/side mutation test.
recommendation: Add symbol+direction to TradePlan and plan_hash (or load Signal by signal_id in execution); assert snapshot.symbol == plan.symbol, side == plan.direction, and side-consistent SL/entry/TP ordering before any adapter call.

invariant_id: INV-063, INV-064, INV-065, INV-083; Corrected Rules 9, 17
summary: No symbol-level rule: a second plan on a symbol with an open position passes the portfolio gate (opposite side always; same side for non-cluster BNB); in one-way mode (positionSide=BOTH, no reduceOnly) the opposite plan's entry nets the existing position out.
expected: At most one strategy position/working entry/approved plan per symbol; opposite-direction plan on an open symbol is NO_TRADE in one-way mode.
actual: p6 ($1000): open BTC LONG $5 + candidate BTC SHORT $4.9 -> OK; BNB LONG + BNB LONG -> OK; BNB LONG + BNB SHORT -> OK.
impact: Unplanned realized PnL, both plans' closePosition protectives armed against a different net position, open-risk ledger counts risk on a flat book; reconcile compare (L7 F-701) will not flag it.
evidence: portfolio.py:322-327 cluster sums only same position_side; no symbol uniqueness check in src/risk or src/execution; manager.py:502,514 positionSide BOTH entry without reduceOnly.
why_tests_miss: Portfolio fixtures use distinct symbols or the same side.
recommendation: Reject candidates whose symbol has an open position, working entry or approved-unplaced plan (either side), under the serialized cap lock of Corrected Rule 9.

summary: Live placement never reads TradePlan.status nor evaluates invalidation_rule_json (close beyond the level); nothing in src ever does. The backtest instead cancels on candle colour (LONG: bar.close < bar.open), a different rule.
expected: An invalidated plan (1H close beyond its invalidation level) cannot be placed or keep resting; the same rule in backtest/paper/live.
actual: grep: invalidation_rule_json only written by the planner; TradePlanStatus never read in execution/approval; simulator.py:393-446 uses bar colour.
impact: Live places setups the strategy has invalidated (until expiry); backtest trade selection differs systematically from live semantics.
evidence: planner.py:425-433 writes {basis:CANDLE_CLOSE, level:SL}; manager.py:241-255 checks only approval status/hash/id/expiry; simulator.py:393-419 `if bar.close < bar.open: INVALIDATION_CANCEL`.
why_tests_miss: No test feeds execute_approved_plan an INVALIDATED plan; simulator tests pin the colour rule.
recommendation: Enforce plan status and evaluate the invalidation rule on the latest closed candle at placement and while the entry rests (expire_pending_entry with trigger 'invalidation'); same rule in the simulator.
known_prior: Partly overlaps KNOWN P15/F-007 (price check, a different gate); backtest proxy quoted in F-120/F-901 evidence but not reported. NEW as stated.

summary: The simulator gates every historical bar against ONE constraint snapshot with a 1h TTL using the bar close as now, so any bar outside [observed_at, observed_at+1h] is STALE_CONSTRAINTS; open_positions, daily_loss_quote and equity are frozen for the whole run, so caps/DAILY_STOP never bind.
expected: Point-in-time constraint snapshot per bar (observed_at <= bar) without a wall-clock TTL in historical mode; a simulated portfolio ledger (open risk, UTC-day loss, equity) feeding the same gates as live.
actual: p7 on phase6/intrabar_both_touched: shipped (observed 1h before the only signal) -> ENTRY_FILLED; snapshot dated after history or at history start -> REJECT STALE_CONSTRAINTS. Portfolio inputs parsed once (simulator.py:713-717) and never updated.
impact: The canonical backtest cannot produce a valid multi-month run without faking metadata per bar; where it runs, it ignores daily-stop/cap behaviour live enforces and overstates trade count.
evidence: simulator.py:714, 807-816 evaluate_risk(now_utc=bar.close_time_utc, ttl=ttl, constraint_snapshot=<single>); portfolio.py:296-306 age>ttl or age<0 -> STALE_CONSTRAINTS; ttl_seconds=3600.
why_tests_miss: Every phase6 fixture pins metadata_observed_at_utc 1h before its single signal bar and an empty position list.
recommendation: Historical mode: select versioned metadata by observed_at <= bar close, drop the wall-clock TTL (keep for live); carry a simulated portfolio ledger through the loop.
known_prior: Related skipped 06-REVIEW CR-04 (run-level now_utc expiry, cited in F-901/F-120); TTL and frozen-state issues NEW.

expected: Slippage quote = price x qty x rate per taker fill (stop exit >= 2-5 bps, 3x stress), same units in sizing and PnL.
actual: BTC qty 0.008 @60000: slippage_amount 0.0000008 USDT instead of 0.48; p1 btLoss$ vs realSL$ e.g. 8.464 vs 8.961 (BTC $1000, 0.1% stop).
impact: Backtest net PnL/expectancy and kill-gate evidence are optimistic; after P11 fixes sizing only, sizing and PnL will disagree on units.
evidence: simulator.py:650-654 `slippage = _mul(quantity, cost_model.expected_slippage)`; baseline-v3 `expected_slippage = 0.0001  # 1 bps`; ROADMAP.md:357 P11 goal names only modeled_costs_per_unit/size_position.

summary: Fills that risk sizing accepted can fail TP1 sizing (floor(filled x 0.5) < minQty, or a spurious MIN_NOTIONAL check on a reduce-only leg); attach then places only the SL and forces ENTRY_WITHOUT_PROTECTIVE + SAFE_MODE instead of falling back to a single TP.
expected: TP1 below minQty -> single close-all TP + SL; no MIN_NOTIONAL on reduce-only legs; MARKET_LOT_SIZE for triggered *_MARKET legs; TP feasibility checked at plan time.
actual: p5: 3/69 risk-accepted grid points (BTC $500 SL 3%/4%, BTC $1000 SL 5%, qty 0.001) -> TP sizing MIN_QTY_REJECT -> SAFE_MODE; any partial fill < 2 x minQty behaves the same.
impact: Protected positions without TPs and a system parked in SAFE_MODE (blocks new entries) on routine small BTC trades/partials; no naked exposure.
evidence: placement.py:397-410 quantize_protective_qty rejects; manager.py:927-933 -> _sl_only_then_hold -> require_protective_confirmation -> enter_safe_mode.
why_tests_miss: Attach tests use fills well above 2 x minQty.
recommendation: Implement the Corrected Rule 16 single-TP fallback, drop notional gating for reduce-only legs, check TP feasibility at risk time.
